product.name: CHEF iQ Smart Pressure Cooker with WiFi and Built-in Scale - Easy-to-Use 10-in-1 Multicooker with 500+ Guided Recipes - Rice Cooker, Slow Cooker, Instant Meals for Foodies - 6 Quart - Family Size
features: THE CHEF iQ APP: Connect to our free app via WiFi and Bluetooth and access hundreds of Guided Cooking recipes and culinary how-to videos, control and monitor your Smart Cooker, and access hundreds of presets for almost any ingredient

BUILT-IN SCALE: Easily measure ingredients and cook by weight, simplifying prep and cleanup: no measuring cups needed Four smart sensors measure ingredients accurately and tell you how much liquid is needed to cook to perfection
AUTO PRESSURE RELEASE: Automatically releases steam at the end of pressure cooking for increased safety and convenience. Programmed with 3 pressure release methods: quick, pulse, and natural
HUNDREDS OF VIDEO-GUDIED RECIPES: Guided Cooking recipes provide step-by-step video instructions and enable you to send precise cooking parameters to your Smart Cooker for every step

GUESS-FREE COOKING: Access hundreds of presets on the Smart Cooker or in the CHEF iQ App. Simply input your ingredient and we’ll provide exact cook settings and recommended cooking functions for easy one-pot meals

WIRELESS UPDATES: Receive wireless firmware updates on your Smart Cooker via the CHEF iQ App. Your Smart Cooker will gain additional features and improve its cooking algorithms while sitting on your countertop

INCLUDED ACCESSORIES: This smart multicooker includes a steamer rack and basket. The rack by itself is perfect for larger items like fish, chicken, or whole vegetables while the basket is ideal for chopped veggies or dumplings
